questions.question: Hemis National Park is located in which of the following Union Terriotories?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Ladakh) है।

questions.question: How do Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) contribute to financial inclusion in India?
options: Providing small-scale loans and other financial services to underserved segments of the population
MFIs restricting their operations to the agricultural sector
Offering large-scale industrial and corporate financing
Focussing solely on urban populations for credit delivery
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Providing small-scale loans and other financial services to underserved segments of the population) है।

questions.question: In which of the following states is the ‘Patkai Bum’ hills located?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Nagaland) है।

questions.question: According to the Constitution (Sixty-first Amendment) Act, 1989, who is eligible to vote in Lok Sabha elections?
options: Any Indian citizen above 30 years of age
Any Indian citizen above 18 years of age
Any Indian citizen above 21 years of age
Any Indian citizen above 25 years of age
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Any Indian citizen above 18 years of age) है।

questions.question: Transportation of food material from one part to another part of plants takes place by ______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (phloem tissues) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an INCORRECT statement about Buddhist architecture?
options: Chaitya is a large apse-shaped pillared hall.
Chaitya has small living quarters for dwelling of monks.
The entrance of chaitya consists of a veranda.
Chaityas are worship places of Buddhists.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Chaitya has small living quarters for dwelling of monks.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to make laws regarding the acquisition and termination of Indian citizenship?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Article 11) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Maharashtra) है।

questions.question: As per Article 74 of the Indian Constitution, who among the following is the Head of the Council of Ministers of the Union Government?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Prime Minister of India) है।

questions.question: Which of the following books is written by Sid Kapdi?

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Indonesia) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (1928) है।

questions.question: What are the two modes of reproduction common to all living organisms?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Sexual and asexual) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Khudai Khidmatgar Movement) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding India's first long-range hypersonic missile trial are correct?1. The missile was successfully tested from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the coast of Odisha.2. The missile was designed to carry payloads for ranges greater than 1,500 km for the Armed Forces.3. The flight trial was conducted by the DRDO in collaboration with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (1 and 2 only) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Young’s Modulus) है।
